metadata.title: Global Ocean Nutrient Stress (2002–2021)
metadata.description: Global ocean map based on two decades of NASA satellite data, showing how warming waters limit nutrients. Red regions indicate the highest nutrient-related stress.

metadata.title: Global Carbon Monoxide (CO) Air Quality (2023)
metadata.description: Near-surface concentration of carbon monoxide (CO) estimated by NASA’s GEOS-CF model. Derived from incomplete combustion, vehicle traffic, industry, and widespread wildfires, illustrating the long-range transport of air pollution.
metadata.source: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO) - GEOS-CF Model
